domains.name: Spanish Constitutional Principles and Democratic Values
Spanish Society, Culture, History, and Geography

exam_name: CCSE (Conocimientos Constitucionales y Socioculturales de España)
exam_price_notes: €85 (~$93 USD) per attempt; can retake if failed
exam_rules: No electronic devices or dictionaries. Oral exams conducted with examiner present or recorded. SIELE is fully computer-based.
id_requirements: Valid government-issued photo ID (Passport, National ID card, or equivalent)

lifecycle.summary: Confirmed current on the issuer host on 2026-09-16: the Instituto Cervantes CCSE pages are live: 'Que es la prueba CCSE' (five tasks, 25 questions per /es/ccse/examen), 2026 convocatorias with inscription deadlines (/es/ccse/cuando: 'CCSE 2026 - Fecha de apertura del plazo de inscripcion: 15 de septiembre de 2025', monthly convocatorias from 29/01/2026), registration via tienda.cervantes.org.

official_study_resources.title: DELE Modelos de Examen (Official Sample Papers)

prerequisites.description: Non-EU national applying for Spanish nationality (naturalización); A2+ Spanish level recommended

renewal_options: DELE certificates have lifetime validity. SIELE is valid for 5 years.

retake_policy.notes: DELE: no limit on retakes; CCSE: can retake immediately if failed
